metadata.title: About Us | GCOM
metadata.description: Explore GCOM, a community for creating games, learning together and finding collaborators at Monash University.

intro.title: About Us
intro.lead: We’re GCOM, the Monash University game development club. We bring people together to explore how games are made and create something of their own.

sections.heading: Ideas are better together.
sections.text: Our mission is to make game development a shared experience: a place to learn, experiment and find collaborators.

sections.heading: Bring your curiosity.
sections.text: You don’t need a finished game or years of experience to get involved. Whether you’re interested in code, art, music, storytelling or design, there’s something to explore.

activities.name: Workshops
activities.text: Learn tools and try new skills.
